params.body:
`systemRead()` passed what `capabilityFor()` returns, `{capability}` or `{refused}`, as the `Control-Capability` header. The pipeline then answered "no mandate came with the request" even when one would have come, and a refusal from Portal never reached the caller.

Now only the signed token travels, and Portal's own reason is thrown when reading is not admitted. Tried against production: `observatory.mjs status` answers "the workbench is not admitted to read on signal-observatory-gentells; the owner admits that layer on the project page in Portal".

params.title: Send only the signed capability on a system read
